name: teamwork-skill
description: Codex-first collaboration skills, with Cursor and Claude Code adapters, for Collaborate, durable workflow documents, research, local evidence, debugging, planning, review, setup, updates, and long-running goals.

interface.shortDescription: Nine focused skills for Collaborate, durable results, research, debugging, review, setup, and goals.
interface.longDescription: Teamwork adds nine focused collaboration skills for one Collaborate workflow covering adaptive dialogue, brainstorming, pressure-testing, and accepted direction convergence; cited external research; read-only local evidence; unknown-cause debugging; executable planning; read-only review; project initialization; global refresh; and long-running convergence. A low-cost Writer turns frozen workflow state into reusable documents through controlled persistence routes and fails closed when route or readback is unavailable. Routine local inspection and authorized implementation stay with Codex's native workflow; no router, Execute skill, retired public Design/Discuss surface, or alias is required. You choose scope and authorize changes; Codex remains in control of tools and permissions.
defaultPrompt: Use $teamwork-update to enable full Teamwork for this Codex plugin.
Use $teamwork-collaborate to brainstorm this problem with me and ask the most useful next question.
Use $teamwork-research to investigate this current external question from primary sources with linked citations.
